basic_info.description: Location, Views & Ideal Floor Plan! Experience breathtaking BAY and CITY views from this exceptional Portola home. The main level features a reverse floor plan, where the living room, complete with a cozy fireplace, the kitchen, and the dining area all showcase panoramic VIEW of the San Francisco skyline and bay. This level also features three spacious, light-filled bedrooms and a bathroom with both a tub and shower. The lower level includes a family room and a half bath. A 3rd level basement with high-ceiling which offers endless potential. The sun-drenched backyard is perfect for entertaining, with ample space for a lush garden and BBQ area. Located in the highly sought-after Portola neighborhood, this home is a TRUE GEM!  Enjoy convenient access to highways 101 and 280, MUNI, and nearby San Bruno Avenue's shopping, coffee and dining options. Proximity to John McLaren Park and local schools adds to the appeal. Don't miss this unique opportunity to own a gem in one of San Francisco's most desirable areas.
